extended:
**Four Equivalent Versions of Non-Abelian Gerbes**

*Thomas Nikolaus a and Konrad Waldorf b*

65 pp, 22 sections.

**Abstract.** We recall and partially improve four versions of smooth, non-abelian gerbes: ˇCech cocycles, classifying maps, bundle gerbes, and principal 2-bundles. We prove that all these four ver- sions are equivalent, and so establish new relations between interesting recent developments. Prominent partial results that we prove are a bijection between the continuous and smooth non- abelian cohomology, and an explicit equivalence between bundle gerbes and principal 2-bundles as 2-stacks.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Preliminaries; 2.1 Lie Groupoids and Groupoid Actions on Mani; 2.2 Principal Groupoid Bundles; 2.3 Anafunctors; 2.4 Lie 2-Groups and crossed Modules; 3 Version I: Groupoid-valued Cohomology; 4 Version II: Classifying Maps; 5 Version III: Groupoid Bundle Gerbes; 5.1 Definition via the Plus Construction; 5.2 Properties of Groupoid Bundle Gerbes; 5.3 Classification by Cech Cohomology; 6 Version IV: Principal 2-Bundles; 6.1 Definition of Principal 2-Bundles; 6.2 Properties of Principal 2-Bundles; 7 Equivalence between Bundle Gerbes and 2-Bund; 7.1 From Principal 2-Bundles to Bundle Gerbes
